subject.title: fix(feishu): accumulate streamed final delta chunks (#91562)

question: After the helper defect and conflict are fixed, should this Feishu streaming-card PR require live Feishu/CardKit proof, or should a maintainer apply a proof override after sanctioned verification?
rationale: The external contributor says they cannot access a live Feishu tenant plus DeepSeek streaming deployment, and ClawSweeper cannot treat helper terminal output plus mocked CardKit tests as sufficient real behavior proof for visible channel delivery.

options.title: Require Repair Plus Live Or Maintainer-Run Proof
options.body: Fix the helper and rebase first, then require either a redacted live Feishu/CardKit artifact or a maintainer-run verification before proof can clear.

options.title: Apply Proof Override After Maintainer Verification
options.body: A maintainer with Feishu access can verify the repaired branch and apply a proof override if the live artifact cannot be posted safely.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Feishu Streaming Work
options.body: Pause or close this branch if maintainers want this latest-token case handled only as part of the broader Feishu streaming-card reliability tracker.

recommendation.title: Require Repair Plus Live Or Maintainer-Run Proof
recommendation.body: Fix the helper and rebase first, then require either a redacted live Feishu/CardKit artifact or a maintainer-run verification before proof can clear.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is currently assigned to vincentkoc and recent Feishu streaming/runtime history makes them the best available routing owner for the proof and repair decision.
